network_enforcement: Every proof-bearing Lean replay runs under Bubblewrap with an unshared network namespace, a read-only host root, a writable disposable module directory, and a cleared fixed environment. Host-side Git, hash, JSON, and tool-identity checks make no network request. This is narrow nonrelease evidence, not a clean empty-cache cold build or offline restoration.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact eight-line PASS/OPEN/BLOCKED negative release summary

scope_boundary: Fail-closed release reconciliation plus a current network-isolated trust-zero replay against existing pinned warm artifacts. It checks current authority, the exact target surface, unconditional Fin 1 bodies, conditional root composition, selected hashes, source hygiene, and both negative terminal decisions. It cannot accept the provisional validation dependency, prove the universal higher-dimensional obstruction, establish H0/R0 or complete trust and provenance, perform a cold empty-cache offline build, supply independent signed runners or a minimal verifier, build a deterministic release bundle, or establish AUDIT-Z/THEOREM-Z.
